items.name: Parga Chasmata
items.origin: Nenets (Samoyed) forest witch. (Feature extent expanded in 2001.)

items.name: Niobe Planitia
items.origin: Greek; her 12 children killed by Artemis and Apollo.

items.name: Aino Planitia
items.origin: Finnish heroine who became water spirit.

items.name: Kawelu Planitia
items.origin: Hawaiian mythological heroine, died and brought back to life.

items.name: Hinemoa Planitia
items.origin: Māori tale heroine; swam across Rotorua Lake to her friend.

items.name: Sedna Planitia
items.origin: Eskimo; her fingers became seals and whales.

items.name: Citlalpul Vallis
items.origin: Aztec name for planet Venus. Name changed from Citlalpul Valles.

items.name: Fonueha Planitia
items.origin: Samoan folktale blind old woman who became the shark.

items.name: Tahmina Planitia
items.origin: Iranian (Farsi) epic heroine, wife of knight Rustam.

items.name: Dzerassa Planitia
items.origin: Ossetian epic heroine; golden-haired daughter of water king.

items.name: Snegurochka Planitia
items.origin: Snow maiden in Russian folktales, melted in spring.

items.name: Lowana Planitia
items.origin: Australian aboriginal tale heroine; lived alone by the sea weaving baskets.

items.name: Wawalag Planitia
items.origin: Yulengor (Arnhemland) tale heroines, two sisters who evolved language.

items.name: Lakshmi Planum
items.origin: Indian goddess of love and war.

items.name: Agrona Linea
items.origin: Welsh goddess of slaughter, destroyer of life.

items.name: Jokwa Linea
items.origin: Japanese "Royal Lady of the West" who waged war with demons and giants, then set the world in order.

items.name: Kanykey Planitia
items.origin: Kyrgyz "Manas" epic tale heroine, wife of the knight Manas.

items.name: Lemkechen Dorsa
items.origin: Berber pole star goddess, holds camel motionless to milk it.

items.name: Kotsmanyako Dorsa
items.origin: Keresan Pueblo mythological girl who scattered the stars into the sky.

items.name: Sinanevt Dorsa
items.origin: Itelmen (Kamchatka) Raven's daughter, wife of sky man.

items.name: Ahsonnutli Dorsa
items.origin: Navajo (N. America) spirit of light and sky.

items.name: Vinmara Planitia
items.origin: Swan maiden whom sea god Qat kept on Earth by hiding her wings (New Hebrides).

items.name: Sogolon Planitia
items.origin: Mandingo (Mali) epic heroine, buffalo-woman, mother of giant.

items.name: Rona Chasma
items.origin: Maori Moon goddess who controls the tides.

items.name: Lauma Dorsa
items.origin: Latvian witch, flies in the sky.

items.name: Poludnitsa Dorsa
items.origin: E. Slavic witch, corn fields deity.

items.name: Tushita Tesserae
items.origin: Hindu deity of resignation to fate. Name changed from Hikuleo Tesserae.

items.name: Manzan Gurme Tesserae
items.origin: Ancestress who possesses the book of fate in Mongol, Tibetan, Buriat mythologies.

items.name: Veleda Linea
items.origin: Warrior goddess of the continental Celts.

items.name: Dziwica Chasma
items.origin: Forest maiden in myths of Luzicke Serby/Sorben/Wenden, W. Slavic group in E. Germany.

items.name: Xi Wang mu Tessera
items.origin: Chinese goddess of west, keeper of medicine for eternal life.

items.name: Shimti Tessera
items.origin: Babylonian; Ishtar as the goddess of fate.

items.name: Jyestha Tesserae
items.origin: Indian goddess of inauspicious things; sister of Lakshmi.

items.name: Mortim Ekva Fluctus
items.origin: Mansi (Ob River Ugra) mistress of "Bird's country".

items.name: Gunda Planitia
items.origin: Abkhazian epic heroine, beautiful sister of the giant knights.

items.name: Kastiatsi Dorsa
items.origin: Acoma (SW USA) name of the rainbow.

items.name: Libuse Planitia
items.origin: Czech tales heroine, wiser of three sisters.

items.name: Likho Tesserae
items.origin: E. Slavic deity of bad fate.

items.name: Nuptadi Planitia
items.origin: Mandan (US Plains) folk heroine; had magic shell robe.

items.name: Pasom mana Tesserae
items.origin: Hopi goddess of dreams and the insane.

items.name: Viriplaca Planum
items.origin: Roman goddess of matrimonial love and happiness.

items.name: Hanghepiwi Chasma
items.origin: Dakota name of the moon and night.

items.name: Husbishag Tesserae
items.origin: Semitic underworld goddess, kept hour of death records.

items.name: Yumyn Udyr Dorsa
items.origin: Marian (Volga Finn) daughter of main god.

items.name: Achek Dorsa
items.origin: Dinka (Sudan) wife of rain god Deng.

items.name: Chernava Colles
items.origin: Russian sea maiden, sea czar's daughter.

items.name: Surupa Dorsa
items.origin: Hindu sky goddess, bringer of rain.

items.name: Laima Tessera
items.origin: Latvian and Lithuanian goddess of fate.

items.name: Tomem Dorsa
items.origin: Ketian (Siberia) Mother of the hot; lives in the sky, near the Sun.

items.name: Ney Anki Fluctus
items.origin: Khanty (Ob River Ugra) mother of fire.

items.name: Juno Chasma
items.origin: Roman sky goddess; sister and consort of Jupiter.
